analysis: Descriptive threshold agreement of published paired OPV measurements
source: Langner et al., Advanced Materials (2020), DOI 10.1002/adma.201907801; original experimental_data.xlsx
threshold_status: Illustrative benchmark criterion selected before computing these threshold-agreement counts; not an established device qualification standard.
inclusion: All 240 SDA pairs, both systems and both merit-function campaigns. No outlier trimming or negative-value clipping.
report: Per system and per source campaign, plus explicitly descriptive combined table. Counts describe this finite dataset; no independence or population confidence claim is made.
limits: Sample 1 and Sample 2 are source labels; temporal order and preparation/reset histories are not inferred.
A disagreement is not a known false acceptance because the true mean material response is unobserved.
Paired disagreement cannot be attributed to carryover without corresponding history/control measurements.
Adaptive campaign selection and shared compositions prevent treating all records as an independent random sample of materials space.
